en.headline:
Making technology
work for business.
en.intro: I connect business problems with data, digital solutions and hands-on delivery. From consulting to enterprise transformation, I turn complex requirements into something teams can use.
en.selectedsub: A look at the systems, analysis and solutions behind my work.
en.approachTitle:
From the right question
to a working solution.
steps: Start with the decision, the process and the people. Make the problem clear before choosing the technology.
Translate requirements into models, architecture and prototypes that people can discuss and test.
Bring stakeholders, delivery and governance together so the solution can become part of everyday work.
en.bio: My work sits between technology and business. I have worked across manufacturing, infrastructure consulting and enterprise data initiatives, combining analytical thinking with practical project delivery.
en.contactText: For conversations about data, digital transformation and building useful things.

zh.headline:
让技术，
真正服务于业务。
zh.intro: 连接业务问题、数据与数字化方案。从咨询到企业转型，我将复杂需求转化为团队能够理解、验证和使用的解决方案。
zh.selectedsub: 从数据分析到系统方案，展示我如何拆解问题并推进交付。
zh.approachTitle:
从明确问题，
到实现解决方案。
steps: 从决策、流程与使用者出发，在选择技术前先明确问题。
将需求转化为模型、架构和原型，让团队能够讨论与验证。
连接业务参与者、项目交付与治理，让方案融入日常工作。
zh.aboutTitle:
以业务为出发点，
用工程思维解决问题。
zh.bio: 我的工作位于技术与业务的交汇处。经历涵盖制造业、基础设施咨询与企业数据建设，注重分析思考，也关注项目的实际推进与交付。
zh.contactTitle:
一起聊聊，
接下来的可能。
zh.contactText: 欢迎交流数据、数字化转型，以及如何把想法做成有用的产品。

en.title: Connecting a global data landscape
en.subtitle: Global Data Hub & Control Tower
en.desc: A shared data foundation for cross-regional visibility and supply-chain decisions.
en.context: Regional teams use different systems and data definitions. A global view requires alignment on data ownership, meaning and operating processes.
en.role: Supporting the definition of the data platform scope, translating business needs into data and system requirements, and coordinating solution discussions.
en.method: Define data contracts and shared metrics; separate technical and business data quality; plan master-data mapping, exception handling and access governance.
en.outcome: Planning and solution development. This case describes the approach, without claiming a completed rollout or quantified business benefits.
en.note: A high-level, anonymised summary. The visual is conceptual and does not reproduce internal architecture.

zh.title: 连接跨区域的数据体系
zh.subtitle: 全球数据平台与 Control Tower
zh.desc: 建立共同的数据基础，支持跨区域可视化与供应链决策。
zh.context: 各区域团队使用不同系统与数据定义。形成全球视角，需要先对齐数据归属、指标含义与运营流程。
zh.role: 协助定义平台范围，将业务需求拆解为数据与系统要求，并协调方案讨论。
zh.method: 定义数据契约与共同指标；区分技术和业务数据质量；规划主数据映射、例外处理与权限治理。
zh.outcome: 处于规划与方案推进阶段。本案例介绍方法，不宣称已全面上线或实现量化收益。
zh.note: 经概括的匿名案例。配图为概念示意，不复现内部架构。

en.title: Making performance easier to see
en.subtitle: Management dashboards & analytics
en.desc: Turning business questions into consistent metrics and useful management views.
en.context: Management reporting needs to connect operational information with the decisions stakeholders make. A dashboard is useful only when its metrics are understood.
en.role: Working with stakeholders on corporate and project KPI frameworks, business analysis and dashboard delivery in infrastructure-related engagements.
en.method: Clarify the decision and metric definitions, map source data, build analytical views, and review usability with stakeholders.
en.outcome: Experience in KPI framework development and analytical delivery. No client data or unverified impact figures are included.
en.note: The charts and calculator are newly created illustrative examples, not screenshots of a client deliverable.

zh.title: 让经营表现更清晰
zh.subtitle: 管理层看板与业务分析
zh.desc: 将业务问题转化为统一指标与可用于管理决策的分析视图。
zh.context: 管理报告需要将运营信息与实际决策连接起来。只有指标被共同理解，看板才有使用价值。
zh.role: 在基础设施相关咨询项目中，与业务参与者共同梳理企业和项目 KPI 框架，参与业务分析与看板交付。
zh.method: 明确决策需求与指标口径，映射数据来源，构建分析视图，并与使用者验证可用性。
zh.outcome: 相关经验涵盖 KPI 框架设计与分析交付。此处不展示客户数据或未经确认的收益数字。
zh.note: 图表和计算器为新制作的说明性示例，不是客户交付物截图。

en.title: From process to practical workflow
en.subtitle: Digital risk management
en.desc: Translating risk-management processes into a more structured digital experience.
en.context: Risk-management activities involve information gathering, ownership, review and follow-up. Making these steps explicit creates a basis for workflow design.
en.role: Helping define risk-management processes and digitise them through workflow solutions in consulting engagements.
en.method: Map the process, clarify responsibilities, define review stages and develop the workflow around business requirements.
en.outcome: Process definition and workflow digitisation experience. Performance improvements are omitted pending confirmation for public use.
en.note: An anonymised professional summary. The flow is an explanatory illustration rather than an internal process specification.

zh.title: 从业务流程到可用工作流
zh.subtitle: 风险管理数字化
zh.desc: 将风险管理流程转化为结构清晰的数字化操作体验。
zh.context: 风险管理涉及信息收集、责任分工、审核与后续跟进。明确这些环节，是设计工作流的基础。
zh.role: 在咨询项目中参与风险管理流程定义，并通过工作流方案推动数字化。
zh.method: 梳理流程，明确责任，定义审核阶段，并根据业务要求构建工作流。
zh.outcome: 相关经验涵盖流程定义与工作流数字化。量化改善数据待确认可公开后再加入。
zh.note: 匿名职业案例。流程图仅用于解释概念，不是内部流程规范。
